vulns.title: Logical-order error: locking an already locked resource throws 500
vulns.switch: DISABLE_LOGICAL_ORDER_ERROR=true turns it off (removes ResourceModule, api.module.ts:8)

vulns.title: Integer overflow: ParseIntPipe id has no range check, huge id reaches DB and causes 500 (same on DELETE /person/{id}, person.controller.ts:96)
Wrong status code: /testStatusCodes always throws 403, spec says 200/400

traps.note: Commented-out string-concatenated SQL; dead code, not executed (the live injectable query is line 21).
Class-level @UseGuards(LoginGuard) covers both GET /persons and GET /persons/:id; looks like missing auth on the id route but it is guarded.
Throttler (1/s, 8/10s, 50/min) is registered as global APP_GUARD unless DISABLE_RATE_LIMITING=true; default compose has it on, so 'no rate limiting' is wrong by default.
console.log of user id looks like log injection, but id is a number from ParseIntPipe, so no attacker-controlled string.
JWT payload contains only sub and username, not the password/email; no credential leak in the token.
